entry_points.text: Boot establishes NUMA/paging defaults with node zero baseline; late ends boot alloc, handles hypervisor, registers vsyscall, preallocates vmalloc and IOMMU.
Early mapping resolves directory from loaded top, indexes boot table, installs window in one directory with masked prot and single fixmaps with flush.
Randomization validates ordering, presets direct end, distributes entropy with aligned offsets and assigns bases.
Debug observer handles only step traps; flush queries installed by early SME.

exports.text: Memory end only grows to computed end and recomputes high bound; block size caches admin/min/advised then halves to fit alignment.
Add validates direct bound with warning, maps with caller prot then adds pages; remove drops pages then tears down direct and vmemmap.
Vmemmap populate needs page alignment, picks base or huge when allowed, errors on altmap without support and syncs tables.
Ioremap variants request caching with caller; WC negotiates memtype; local downgrades without PAT; WB picks cached/encrypted; dev maps page.
Memtype reserve validates, negotiates, enforces policy and syncs maps; release frees base through base plus size.
Confidentiality forces DMA rule, refreshes bounce/time, scales bounce, tags protections encrypted and maps low boot data.
Helpers test fault-free read admissibility in two builds, report 32/64-bit sizes and randomize mmap offset by mode.
Host repairs SNP maps and encrypts kernel in place; tracing inits fault hash with trap observer and warns on leftovers.

hazards.text: Setup warns on temp-map failure; early warns on window span; fixmap halts on out-of-range index.
Unaligned tables risk faults and kexec reuse; ROM scan and compat syscalls risk crashes and abuse.

invariants.text: Unused caches start with zero empty; flush fills to align; whole-PMD scans; used prefers contiguity; large tracks ranges; reuse marks used.
Release picks reserved/table or altmap/buddy; empty tables free only when all children empty.
Vmalloc preallocates by top steps failing boot on error; finalization write-protects text-rodata, secures tracing and frees gaps.
RAM check reports unreserved system-RAM frames; encrypted idle without guest support; collection completes only with both indications.
Decrypted for persistent/firmware; firmware-data only with boot; RAM policy varies by encryption; early prot adjusts; phys delegates.
Padding is TB bytes; direct shrinks to observed plus padding unless device-private.
Reclaim defers freeing to zero-ref; admissibility needs above limit, canonical, not guard/syscall.
DMA forced by guest/IOMMU limits; init scales bounce and restricts virtio; SNP reserves enclosing 2M; early maps 2M steps preserving cmdline then flushes.
Shared precedes clearing, private follows; TLB always flushes, cache conditionally; SME installs hooks; boot crypto-copies; mmap derives clamped top.

locks.text: Every entry clear during teardown and empty-table free holds initial address-space page-table lock.
One spin lock guards fault hash; regcount under RCU; post rearm and removal hold lock, removal with IRQs disabled.

state_machines.text: Teardown walks top to leaves skipping absent, handles leaves with alignment, recurses mixed, frees emptied and flushes; direct adjusts counts, vmemmap frees backing; low 1G aborts sweep.
Setup walk reports exact/contained matches, follows indirect, releases temp maps and ends false; early uses decrypted map.
Early shadow fills tables and clears ranges with L5/folded handling; full copies top, repopulates regions, restores and inits.
Trap flows filter to active to probe completion to locked rearm; idle frees, busy detaches; unexpected/inactive traps warn and ignore.
Encryption flows early request through prepare for shared to table update and finish for private with hypercall.

structs.text: Remap descriptor holds single flags word; boot fixed mapping is one cleared page-sized PTE table for boot window.
Regions have base/end and TB size; TB shift 40; ceiling entry base; gap 128M; entropy widths; header guard; align all-set.
Fault pages carry links/addr/flags/count; delayed batches release; per-CPU holds active fault; hash 4 bits/16 buckets.
Unused vmemmap fill 253; max hotplug block 2G; large-block threshold 64G.
Kasan log prefixes name; early L5 empty; fixed top negated page; segments extent low 20 base 20-51.
